newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end down on loose liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end down on loose liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Thursday amid widespread expectations that liquidity would remain loose during the June reserve period that opened on Wednesday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.687 percent against Wednesday's 6.211 close -- only slightly above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 5.50 against 5.65-5.75.
Dealers said the falls reflected optimism of easing liquidity in the banking system.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.7995-8000 percent against 5.8375-8380.
